answer: Weakest link is identity cost: one operator mints many agents, so per-agent reputation looks independent. Defense: a rotating bonded mesa of validators each stake and sign a whisper of observed behavior; an agent’s score counts only when its ripple reaches independent validator clusters, not one quorum. Break one validator and you add noise, not control: payout still needs cross-cluster agreement plus slashing, so cheap sybils drown in uncorrelated attestations rather than beat the mechanism.
